meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找出之前会话的解法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从过往会话中找回解法与结论
copy.tagline_en: Search past sessions for prior solutions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to dig up past session solutions and decisions

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能搜历史会话存档:先给出带 ID 的搜索结果列表,再看相关时间线上下文,最后只对选中 ID 批量取完整记录。
howto.when: 当用户问起以前的会话,比如「这事我们之前解决过吗?」「上次是怎么做 X 的?」「上周发生了什么?」时触发。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么解决登录问题的?
say.note: Claude 会先搜索引,再按需取详情。

say.text: 查一下上周关于 JWT 认证的记录
say.note: 可加项目名等条件缩小范围。

say.text: 把 #11131 和 #10942 的完整记录取出来
say.note: 会用批量接口一次取回多条。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search your stored history from past sessions. It first returns a search result list with IDs, then views relevant timeline context, and only fetches full records for selected IDs in batch.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about previous sessions, e.g. 'did we already solve this?', 'how did we do X last time?', or 'what happened last week?'.

say_en.text: How did we solve the login issue last time?
say_en.note: Claude will search the index first, then fetch details as needed.

say_en.text: Find records about JWT authentication from last week.
say_en.note: You can add a project name to narrow results.
Uses batch fetch to get multiple observations at once.
